# Generative AI on Google Cloud > The latest Gemini models are available! Try out [Gemini 3.7 Flash](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/generative-ai/blob/main/gemini/getting-started/intro_gemini_3_7_flash.ipynb). > > **[Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform)**, the latest evolution of Vertex AI, has been released! > > Check out the [`Google-Cloud-AI/agent-platform`](https://goo.gle/agent-platform-github) repository for a curated list of assets for agent building on Google Cloud. This repository contains notebooks, code samples, sample apps, and other resources that demonstrate how to use, develop and manage generative AI workflows using [Generative AI](https://cloud.google.com/ai/generative-ai) with [Agent Platform](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform). ## Intro Video
Description

gemini/ 		Discover Gemini through starter notebooks, use cases, function calling, sample apps, and more.

search/ 		Use this folder if you're interested in using Agent Search, a Google-managed solution to help you rapidly build search engines for websites and across enterprise data. (Formerly known as Enterprise Search on Generative AI App Builder).

rag-grounding/ 		Use this folder for information on Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and Grounding. This is an index of notebooks and samples across other directories focused on this topic.

vision/ 		Use this folder if you're interested in building your own solutions from scratch using features from Imagen and Veo.

audio/ 		Use this folder if you're interested in building your own solutions from scratch using features from Chirp, a version of Google's Universal Speech Model (USM).

setup-env/ 		Instructions on how to set up Google Cloud, the Gen AI Python SDK, and notebook environments on Google Colab and Workbench.

RESOURCES.md 		Learning resources (e.g. blogs, YouTube playlists) about Generative AI on Google Cloud.
## Related Repositories - ✨ [Agent Development Kit (ADK) Samples](https://github.com/google/adk-samples): This repository provides ready-to-use agents built on top of the Agent Development Kit, designed to accelerate your development process. These agents cover a range of common use cases and complexities, from simple conversational bots to complex multi-agent workflows. - [🚀 Agent Starter Pack](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/agent-starter-pack) - A collection of production-ready Generative AI Agent templates built for Google Cloud. - It accelerates development by providing a holistic, production-ready solution, addressing common challenges (Deployment & Operations, Evaluation, Customization, Observability) in building and deploying Gen AI agents. - Generative AI on Google Cloud

The latest Gemini models are available! Try out Gemini 3.7 Flash.

Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, the latest evolution of Vertex AI, has been released!

Check out the Google-Cloud-AI/agent-platform repository for a curated list of assets for agent building on Google Cloud.

This repository contains notebooks, code samples, sample apps, and other resources that demonstrate how to use, develop and manage generative AI workflows using Generative AI with Agent Platform.

Intro Video

Description

gemini/ 		Discover Gemini through starter notebooks, use cases, function calling, sample apps, and more.

search/ 		Use this folder if you're interested in using Agent Search, a Google-managed solution to help you rapidly build search engines for websites and across enterprise data. (Formerly known as Enterprise Search on Generative AI App Builder).

rag-grounding/ 		Use this folder for information on Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and Grounding. This is an index of notebooks and samples across other directories focused on this topic.

vision/ 		Use this folder if you're interested in building your own solutions from scratch using features from Imagen and Veo.

audio/ 		Use this folder if you're interested in building your own solutions from scratch using features from Chirp, a version of Google's Universal Speech Model (USM).

setup-env/ 		Instructions on how to set up Google Cloud, the Gen AI Python SDK, and notebook environments on Google Colab and Workbench.

RESOURCES.md 		Learning resources (e.g. blogs, YouTube playlists) about Generative AI on Google Cloud.

Related Repositories

aiSummary.oneLiner: A comprehensive collection of sample code, notebooks, and tutorials for building generative AI applications on Google Cloud.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository serves as Google Cloud's official hub for generative AI examples and best practices. It provides developers with concrete, runnable code demonstrating how to integrate Google's foundation models (like Gemini) and AI infrastructure (like Vertex AI) into real-world applications. The repo covers a massive surface area, from simple prompt engineering and text generation to complex RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, multimodal analysis, and agentic workflows. By providing reference implementations in Python, Node.js, and Java, it helps teams bridge the gap between reading API documentation and deploying functional AI features in enterprise environments. It essentially acts as a living cookbook for the Google Cloud AI ecosystem.
keyFeatures: Extensive Jupyter notebooks: Step-by-step tutorials for interacting with Vertex AI and Gemini APIs.
RAG implementations: Reference architectures for grounding LLMs in enterprise data using Vector Search.
Multimodal examples: Code showing how to process and analyze text, images, video, and audio simultaneously.
Agent and tool use: Demonstrations of connecting models to external APIs and databases for action-taking.
Multi-language support: Examples provided in Python, Node.js, Java, and Go.
Enterprise integration: Guides on using LangChain, LlamaIndex, and other frameworks within Google Cloud.

useCases.title: Learning Vertex AI
useCases.description: Developers new to Google Cloud use the introductory notebooks to understand how to authenticate and call the Gemini API.

useCases.title: Building RAG systems
useCases.description: Enterprise teams copy reference architectures to build internal knowledge bots grounded in their own documents.

useCases.title: Multimodal processing pipelines
useCases.description: Engineers build systems that automatically extract metadata and summaries from uploaded videos and images.

useCases.title: Evaluating LLM outputs
useCases.description: Data scientists use provided scripts to benchmark different prompts and models against custom evaluation datasets.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This repository is intended for software engineers, data scientists, and cloud architects building applications on Google Cloud Platform. It requires familiarity with cloud concepts, basic machine learning principles, and programming in Python or Node.js.
